name: Integer-based Amanatides and Woo Voxel Traversal
definition: An integer-based algorithm for traversing a 3D voxel grid along a ray, designed to be fast, exact, and stable by avoiding floating-point arithmetic, using scaled integer values for distance calculations to prevent precision errors.
summary: Integer-based Amanatides and Woo Voxel Traversal determines ray-grid intersections using scaled integer arithmetic to ensure exactness without floating-point operations or post-hoc error correction.
